senses.gloss: (abbrev. of יֵשׁוּעַ) pr. n. m. Jesus of Nazareth.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 107b:14">Ib. 107ᵇ</cite> (represented as a disciple of R. Joshua b. P’raḥia, with whom he fled to Egypt); <cite ref="Sotah 47a:14">Sot. 47ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17a:1">Ab. Zar. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מצאתי אדם אחד מתלמידי י׳ הנוצרי ויעקב וכ׳</he> I met one of the disciples of J. the Nazarean whose name was Jacob (v. <cite ref="J00496"><he>יַעֲקֹב</he></cite> 5); <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:24">Tosef. Ḥull. II, 24</cite> <he>יֵשׁוּעַ בן פנטירי</he> (Var. <cite ref="Q01186"><he>פנטרי</he></cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:22">Ib. 22</cite> <he>ובא … ישוע בן פנטרא</he> and Jacob … came to cure him with the name of J. the son of Pantera; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 27b">Ab. Zar. 27ᵇ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300); Y. ib. II, 40ᵈ bot. <he>נימא לך בשם י׳ בן פנדרא</he> shall I speak a charm to thee in the name of J. the son of Pandera; Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ bot. <he>משם של ישו פנדירא …</he> <cite ref="Yoma 2a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ולחש ליה משמיה די׳ פ׳</he> and he whispered to him a charm, in behalf of J. P.; [In Babli editions published unter censorial restrictions all the above quoted passages are omitted or changed; in <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:8">Koh. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>פלני</he> is substituted.]
